maya: heads up — bringing up the new 13B-v2-open checkpoint with int4-hybrid quant for longctx perf. seeing a weird divergence when warm-starting KV vs cold-start runs :thinking:

maya: quick summary:
- cold start (no prefills) -> outputs match baseline at 8k and 16k
- warmstart (prefill + adaptive prefetch) -> small token-level drift after ~3k tokens on quantized runs
- single-rep seed, repro pretty consistent across GPU types

maya: repro logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] run=warmstart-1 seq=8192 seed=42 mode=int4-hybrid
[2026-03-20T14:12:17Z] step=3072 token_idx=3072 kv_checksum=0x7f2a1c3b
[2026-03-20T14:12:17Z] step=3073 token_idx=3073 kv_checksum=0x7f2a1c3d  # checksum changed
[2026-03-20T14:12:18Z] drift_detected tokens=4 first_div_at=3075
```

maya: config snippet we used:
```
serve.run_mode: warmstart
kv.prefetch.enabled: true
kv.prefetch.stride: adaptive
quant.mode: hybrid-int4
rope.scale_policy: auto
```

alex_m: can you paste the exact CLI to reproduce? i'll run a cold vs warm diff on my rig.

maya: sure —
`./run_eval.sh --model 13b-v2 --quant hybrid-int4 --ctx 8192 --prefill warm --seed 42 --save-checksums /tmp/csum`

kevin_r: numbers I ran locally earlier:
- coldstart int4-hybrid 8k: latency p50=220ms, p95=430ms, token match=100%
- warmstart int4-hybrid 8k: latency p50=180ms, p95=360ms, token match=99.94% (mismatch ~6 tokens / 10k)
- warmstart fp16 8k: token match=100% (so looks quant specific)

kevin_r: also ran a small ablation, turning off `kv.prefetch.stride: adaptive` -> warmstart token match = 99.999% (1/10k)

sam: hypothesis: adaptive stride + quantized kernels cause tiny phase offsets in the RoPE embedding when we reuse cached KV shards; quantized dequant/rescale ordering may not be bit-exact with the fp path causing small numerical drift which then compounds under autoregressive sampling.

sam: could be the `rope.scale_policy: auto` picked a different rescale factor for quant kernels. try forcing `rope.scale_policy: fixed_v1` and rerun.

maya: running that now. also queueing a 32k run but that'll take longer.

ci-bot: test run queued -> https://ci.internal.redwood/tests/5333333333/warm-vs-cold-int4-hybrid

alex_m: thanks — i'll add a quick diff script that compares kv-checksums and per-token logits between runs. if we see consistent checksum divergence point we can bisect which kernel change causes it.

maya: mini-results: forcing `rope.scale_policy: fixed_v1` reduced mismatches to 0/10k on my 8k warmstart run. so likely RoPE rescaling mismatch.

kevin_r: great find. next steps:
- patch quant kernel pipeline to apply fixed rescale on dequant path (PR draft)
- run A/B across 8k/32k and cold/warm with N=5 seeds
- add unit test: apply prefill+replay and assert kv_checksum stability across quant vs fp paths

maya: i'm updating the onboarding checklist for this model: include `rope.scale_policy` lock for quantized brings until kernel fix is in.

sam: also add note to docs: `kv.prefetch.stride: adaptive` known to interact with quantized dequant timing — temporary mitigation: set `adaptive=false` for int4-hybrid in Release Notes v0.41.

alex_m: i'll own the bisect and PR. tagging @kevin_r and @maya for test verification. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks, everyone. i'll attach full logs and the 32k run once it finishes.
